d: Usman Khawaja’s new autobiography Sabr has reignited the 2018 Sandpapergate scandal after the former Australian opener claimed the entire team, not just Steve Smith, David Warner and Cameron Bancroft, knew about the ball-tampering plan that used sandpaper in Cape Town. Khawaja alleged the practice began in the previous Test at Port Elizabeth, that coaching staff were involved, and that he himself had warned Bancroft to be careful.
